note: Real, provider-neutral Compute Resource Registry (owner, 2026-08-10, DigitalOcean AI Inference Infrastructure Control & Billing Layer). Reconciles the real, already-flagged inconsistency in registry/PROVIDER_DIRECTORY.json's runpod entry ('system-config/route.ts's GPU widget separately reports "No GPU/RunPod adapter in codebase"') by giving compute resources (GPU Droplets, Dedicated Inference deployments, RunPod pods, or any future provider's compute) ONE real, structured place to register — never hardcoded per-provider. Written/read only via app/api/admin/ide/_lib/computeResourceRegistryRuntime.ts.
schema_note: resources[]: provider (string, e.g. "digitalocean"|"runpod"), provider_resource_id (string, the real id/name the provider itself uses), cpu_cores (number|null), ram_gb (number|null), gpu (string|null, e.g. "NVIDIA H100"), vram_gb (number|null), storage_gb (number|null), region (string|null), price_per_hour (number|null), currency (string|null), runtime_status (string, e.g. "running"|"stopped"|"provisioning"|"unknown"), health (string, e.g. "HEALTHY"|"DEGRADED"|"UNKNOWN"), current_workload (string|null, free-text description of what's running there, or null if idle/unknown), last_verified_at (ISO8601|null, when this entry's real fields were last confirmed against the live provider — null if never verified).
honesty_note: Starts empty. No real RunPod pod or DigitalOcean Dedicated Inference deployment was queried live this build (no live credentials/session available for either at the time of writing) — never backfilled with a guessed or remembered entry. A real entry is added only via upsertComputeResource() after a real, live query against the provider's own API.
